[d0807] config | spool.threshold_percent (PaderQueue 2.x) | version 2.x
# `spool.threshold_percent` (PaderQueue 2.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 2.x.

Usage level in percent at which the on-disk spool that buffers incoming messages before they are written to segments starts throttling.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer (percent) |
| Default | `90` |
| Available since | 2.1 |
| Component | spool |
| Unit | % |

## Tuning advice

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `spool.threshold_percent` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[spool]
threshold_percent = 90
```

- New option `quota.enabled`: turns the quota manager that limits the throughput per tenant on or off.

- New option `spool.batch_size`: number of messages the on-disk spool that buffers incoming messages before they are written to segments processes together in one batch.

- New option `partitioner.compression`: compression codec that the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written uses for stored or transferred data.

- New option `snapshotter.threshold_percent`: usage level in percent at which the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues starts throttling.

[d0835] config | spool.log_level | version 4.x
# `spool.log_level`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Log verbosity of the on-disk spool that buffers incoming messages before they are written to segments.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | enum: debug | info | warn | error |
| Default | `warn` |
| Available since | 3.1 |
| Component | spool |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `spool.log_level` only if you observe problems with the on-disk spool that buffers incoming messages before they are written to segments, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[spool]
log_level = "warn"
```

---

[d0365] config | retention.threshold_percent | version 4.x
# `retention.threshold_percent`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Usage level in percent at which the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period starts throttling.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer (percent) |
| Default | `95` |
| Available since | 1.1 |
| Component | retention |
| Unit | % |
| Default changed | in 3.0 (see release notes) |

## Notes

Changes to `retention.threshold_percent` take effect after restarting the node. In clusters, use the same value on all nodes.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[retention]
threshold_percent = 95
```

ANSWER:
`spool.threshold_percent` determines when the disk-based spool begins throttling, based on its usage level (percent). The default is `95%` in PaderQueue 4.x and `90%` in PaderQueue 2.x.
